items.title: Marvell Technology Stocks Surge 12.22% as AI Optics Rally Eases Lumentum Deal Doubts

items.title: NetApp's Q2 Gross Margin Guide: Is Another Sequential Dip Ahead?
items.summary: NTAP expects lower gross margins in Q2 fiscal 2027 as rising component costs and a higher product revenue mix offset pricing gains and strong sales growth.

items.title: Seagate Expands Storage Portfolio With FireCuda Forge Launch
items.summary: STX expands its storage portfolio with FireCuda Forge, combining SSD speed and HDD capacity as demand for high-capacity storage solutions continues to grow.

items.title: Seagate Soars 10% as CoreWeave’s “Breakout Quarter” Eases AI Spending Fears
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSeagate shares rose 10% today after CoreWeave beat estimates and raised its 2026 guidance. The selloff in Seagate and Western Digital went well beyond any slowdown in AI storage demand.

items.title: Why Sandisk and Lumentum Are Leading the AI Comeback
items.summary: The memory-card supplier surges as part of a broad AI revival, bolstering hopes it could be about to end a dismal recent run.

items.title: Seagate Spikes 9%, Sandisk Surges 8% as CoreWeave’s Results Revive AI Trade; Micron Climbs 7%
items.summary: After a brutal month of losses, memory and storage stocks are snapping back on one cloud provider's financing plan. Analysts disagree on whether the bounce has legs, and the answer hinges on how AI buildouts get paid for.
